tools.name: list_students
tools.description: Lists the connected personal trainer's students with status, goal and start date. Optionally filter by part of the name. Use the returned student_id with get_student.

tools.name: get_student
tools.description: Gets one of the trainer's students: profile (goal, age, weight, height), the active workouts with their exercises, sets, reps and load, and the latest logged sessions with how many in the last 30 days.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Lists the trainer's classes and appointments between two dates (today and the next 7 days by default): date and time, student, type, status, place and notes. Times are in Brazil time (America/Sao_Paulo).

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Lists what the trainer's students paid or owe: amount, student, due date, paid date and status. Use status "overdue" for unpaid charges past their due date, "open" for everything not paid yet, "paid" for received payments. Totals are in BRL.

tools.name: create_student
tools.description: Adds a student to the trainer's account, like "Adicionar aluno" in the app: the student gets an e-mail invite to install the app and see workouts. Name and e-mail are required; goal, weight, height, birth date and sex are optional. Respects the student limit of the trainer's plan.

tools.name: search_exercises
tools.description: Searches the Trainer Connect exercise library (with demo videos), in Portuguese or English: "supino", "agachamento", "remada", "glúteo", "esteira". Returns the exercise id to pass as edb_exercise_id in create_workout, so the student sees the video.

tools.name: create_workout
tools.description: Creates a workout, assigned to a student (student_id) or as a template when student_id is empty, with its exercises: sets, reps (or a range with reps_max), load, rest, duration for cardio, notes. Exercises are matched to the Trainer Connect library by name so the student sees the demo video (or pass

tools.name: schedule_class
tools.description: Books a class or appointment on the trainer's schedule (Brazil time, America/Sao_Paulo), with a student or as a personal block when student_id is empty. The student is notified, like in the app. Cancelling or moving a class is done in the app (or with api_write on /v1/appointments/{id} where that to

tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: Lists the Trainer Connect app operations this connection can run (method, path, summary): students, workouts and programs, exercise library, schedule and classes, workout sessions and history, physical assessments, anamnesis, diet plans and nutrition, check-ins, chat, contracts, charges and payments

tools.name: describe_operation
tools.description: Shows what oneTrainer Connect operation accepts: route parameters and the validation rules of each field (required, type, allowed values). Use it before api_write so the request is right the first time.

tools.name: api_read
tools.description: Runs any GET operation from list_operations as the connected trainer and returns the same JSON the app gets: a student's assessments, anamnesis, diet plan, workout history and sessions, check-ins, chat messages, contracts, financial metrics, the exercise library and more. Same permissions as the app

tools.name: api_write
tools.description: Runs any POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE operation from list_operations as the connected trainer, exactly as the app would: edit or archive workouts, assign programs, log or edit a session, create assessments, diet plans and check-ins, send chat messages, cancel or move classes, create contracts and char

tools.name: find_trainers
tools.description: Find personal trainers listed in the public Trainer Connect directory (most are in Brazil; some are Brazilian trainers abroad), by specialty, name, city or state, and online or in-person. Specialties are written in Portuguese, e.g. "musculação", "emagrecimento", "funcional", "corrida", "hipertrofia"

tools.name: get_trainer
tools.description: Show the public profile of one personal trainer from the Trainer Connect directory: bio, specialties, where they work, online or in person, and the plans they publish with price and billing period. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "api_write" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Runs any POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE operation from list_operations as the connected trainer, exactly as the app would: edit or archive workouts, assign programs…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_operations, api_read, api_write, get_trainer · Private data: api_write, find_trainers, get_trainer · Public sink: api_write, get_trainer · Destructive: list_operations, api_write.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_operations, api_read, api_write, get_trainer · Private data: api_write, find_trainers, get_trainer · Public sink: api_write, get_trainer · Destructive: list_operations, api_write

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
